artworks.title: a) Au front de Vincennes, Bolo pacha (recto); b) Sketch for Au front de Vincennes, Bolo pacha (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink and black chalk on wove paper
b) black chalk and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing side by side. The drawing is done in a sketchy, expressive style using pencil or charcoal on a plain background. There are two main figures in the foreground. The figure on the left is leaning forward with arms behind them, while the figure on the right stands upright wearing a uniform and a hat. In the background, faint outlines of additional figures are visible, adding depth to the scene. The lines are simple and rough, creating a sense of immediacy and tension.

artworks.title: Soldiers Preparing a Meal
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of three figures in various postures. The drawing shows three figures in casual poses. Two figures are seated and one is standing, slightly leaning forward as if engaged in conversation. The figures wear different types of hats. The drawing uses soft strokes to create a sketch-like quality, focusing on conveying gesture and atmosphere rather than specific details.

artworks.title: Refugees
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a side profile of a person's entire body leaning forward, appearing to push or pull an object, possibly a cart. The figure has facial features with a visible forehead, nose, and mouth, and their hair is mostly covered by a dark headscarf. The person is wearing a long dress or robe, drawn with heavy pencil shading. Two smaller figures, likely children, are sketched beside and behind the person, with minimal facial features. One child is positioned ahead, possibly holding something, while the other follows closely behind. The background is blank, creating emphasis on the figures and cart, with no details of jewelry or specific objects being held. The scene is sketched in pencil on a plain surface.

artworks.title: Le demobilisé
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The illustration depicts the upper bodies of two people, a man and a child, standing closely together. The man is leaning slightly forward with a contemplative facial expression, short dark hair, and a pipe in his mouth. He is wearing a jacket and trousers. The child, a young girl, is positioned in front of the man, looking upwards at him with her head resting against his chest. She wears a knee-length dress. In the background, there is a chair to the right with a helmet and cloth draped over it.

artworks.title: a) Poilu and Nurse (recto); b) Sketch for the Poilu (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and brown and black ink on wove paper
b) brush and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a simple, monochromatic style. The figure on the left is standing upright, facing right, wearing a long coat and a helmet that covers their head. The figure on the right appears to be sitting or leaning against a rectangular structure.

artworks.title: The Taking of Fort Douaumont
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in dynamic movement. The figures are captured in mid-action, appearing to leap or be propelled forward. Both figures are outlined predominantly with black lines, with certain areas shaded to suggest movement or volume. The drawing uses minimal color, primarily in the form of pale facial tones and faint earth-toned shading on the ground. The sketch-like lines convey a sense of immediacy and vivacity. There is a sense of motion within the figures' dynamic poses as they seemingly move through an unseen landscape.

artworks.title: Two Soldiers Looking at a Placard
artworks.medium: black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures from the waist up. The figure on the left is seated, viewed slightly from the side, while the figure on the right appears to be standing, with a leg partially visible to suggest a sitting or squat position. Both figures have minimal facial features and short hair. The clothing and accessories are suggested with light pencil strokes. The figure on the right is holding a long object, possibly a rifle, and there is an indistinct rectangular object on a stand in front of the seated figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: German Advance
artworks.medium: brush with black and brown ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing of two soldiers on the left, one lying on their stomach and seen from behind, and the other in profile, looking down at the lying soldier. Both soldiers wear helmets and appear to be in military uniforms. Behind them, faint lines suggest other soldiers and military equipment in the distance, all heading towards the left. Outside of these shapes, the background is blank beige paper. There is a thin line of text at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: a) La fête nationale (The National Holiday) (recto); b) Woman Holding Child (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and brown and black ink over black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person next to a large wooden pole in abstract surroundings. The drawing features minimalistic and expressive linework. The person is crouched next to a tall, jagged structure that appears to be a pole or beam. Abstract lines suggest a rocky terrain or rubble around the figure. The background is mostly empty, highlighting the central interaction between the figure and the structure.

artworks.title: Sur le Rhin.  -maintenant c'est l'arriere.
artworks.medium: black crayon and graphite with black and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts two individuals from the waist up. The person on the right is a bearded man wearing a helmet, holding a rifle over his shoulder, and has a pipe in his mouth. His attire consists of a military-style jacket. He has a serious expression, and his hair is hidden under the helmet. To the left is another individual looking upwards with an indistinct facial expression, wearing a cap. The clothing of this figure is less detailed than the man on the right. In the background is a signpost with the word "NOYON" written on it. The background is plain with no other notable features.

artworks.title: a) Kammerade.  Porquoi cette froideur? (recto); b) Study for German Figure (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts two figures, both shown from head to toe. The figure on the left is in an animated position, with one arm extended outward and the other reaching towards the second figure. This person has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a closed mouth, and is wearing a brimmed cap. Their clothing appears to be a long coat or robe, drawn in lighter strokes of pencil. The second figure, on the right, stands facing the first figure with their hands near their sides. This person's facial features are less defined. They are wearing a similar style of clothing but with less detail. There is no jewelry visible on either figure, and no objects are being held. The background consists of light sketching, suggesting a rough, rocky terrain or rubble.

artworks.title: Le pas de l'oie - dans le sang
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure created with sweeping lines and angular shapes, suggesting movement. The exaggerated pose and limbs resemble a marching soldier, with a pointed helmet on the head. Loose lines around the figure indicate motion. The composition has a dynamic and abstract quality that may evoke military themes.

artworks.title: A Versailles.  L'envoye des boches
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: In the image, two figures are show. One on the left is a woman viewed from the back in a partial profile, wearing a dress. She stands next to a table with papers and an object. The figure on the right is a reclining man on a bed or couch, with his head on a pillow and one arm up. The man has closed eyes, a mustache, and wears a robe. Drawings of two men in helmets are on the wall above him. The background has plain walls.

artworks.title: The Hats of the Allies [recto]
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows two individuals from slightly above the waist up, leaning forward over a table. The person on the left has medium-length hair covering their facial features, while the individual on the right is bald and wearing glasses. Both wear long-sleeved outfits and are engaging with objects on the table, including cylindrical items that might be containers or drums, and a rod or stick nearby. The background is plain and simple.

artworks.title: Hiding the "louis" [verso]
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a simple pencil and ink sketch of two individuals on a plain background. Both figures are depicted in full-body outline. The left figure is bent forward and leaning slightly, with their head pointed downwards. The right figure stands with a slight forward lean and a pointed hat. Both wear loose-fitting garments. There are no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Ceux de la priemiere heure. "Sire! ou en somme-nous de la guerre fraiche et joyeuse!"
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person in full-body profile leaning forward in motion. The person wears a pointed hat or helmet and a cape flowing behind them. The sketch lacks detailed facial features. The person's clothing is form-fitting with no visible objects. The background is minimally detailed with textured lines suggesting motion or speed.

artworks.title: Les notables
artworks.medium: black crayon corrected and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around an individual playing a piano. The sketch is primarily in black and white with a few colored details, such as the face of one figure. The gathering shows figures in long garments, and the piano player is in mid-motion. The background has a loose, sketchy quality with architectural forms in the distance. The texture and shading give a sense of dynamism and movement, suggesting lively interactions.

artworks.title: Sur le Front.  -C'est sa theorie?  -Non, c'est son breviaire.
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two figures in a landscape setting. One figure in the foreground is walking while reading a book, wearing a coat and hat. Another pair of figures can be seen in the bottom-left corner. The background features a simple horizon line and emptiness. The drawing shows delicate line work, detailed textures in the clothing, and subtle shading. Handwriting is included in the lower-right corner.

artworks.title: Au Pireê.  -Le depart des boches.
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier expelling two men from a boat. The image features black and white shading and depicts a scene where a soldier is pushing away two distressed figures. The soldier is wearing a uniform with a cap and has a rifle slung over his shoulder. The drawing uses bold, expressive lines to convey movement and tension. The background shows water with wave outlines, suggesting the setting is on a boat. The drawing captures a moment of power and conflict.

artworks.title: Quand le boche se retire...
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene illustrating movement or action. The image portrays a dynamic scene with figures interacting in a struggle or dance. The forms show a sense of motion through flowing lines and twisting postures. The central focus is on two shapes entangled with each other, suggesting tension or conflict. Each figure has distinct characteristics, with one leaning back while holding onto the central form. The composition features intricate crosshatching and expressive line work, suggesting depth and emotion. The line work captures the essence of the moment.

artworks.title: En 1871
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two half-body figures. One figure, on the left, is standing upright wearing a long-sleeved garment with an emblem over the chest. He has a mustache, short hair, and a stern expression, with one hand on his hip. The second figure, on the right, is less detailed, leaning forward with an obscured face and short hair. The sketch is set on a plain, light-colored background with scribbles and the phrase "En 1871" and a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Au fil de la marne
artworks.medium: red chalk, black crayon, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing showing small stones or rocks scattered in a flowing body of water. The perspective is slightly elevated, with no distinct horizon line visible. The rocks are partially submerged and depicted with flowing lines. The drawing uses quick, loose strokes in reddish-brown and dark gray tones, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is soft and minimal, with pale beige paper and contrast from reddish-brown tones. In the distance, the marks become lighter, creating depth. The artist has signed the piece at the bottom, along with a small handwritten note.

artworks.title: Au Front de Vincennes, Bolo pacha
artworks.medium: crayon in black and blue and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures in the foreground and several figures in the background. The larger part of the body is shown of both foreground figures, who appear to be in a standing and interacting position. The person on the left in the foreground displays a facial expression with a mustache and short hair that is slightly unkempt. He appears to be wrapped in a draped garment or coat. The person behind him appears to be holding him, and is wearing a cap and uniform with a visible belt. In the background, there is a faintly sketched group of people facing the same direction, potentially a firing squad, with long rifles. The background is indistinct but suggests an outdoor setting with sparse details.

artworks.title: Two Soldiers
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward slightly, while the person on the right is kneeling. The person on the left is depicted with a more defined sketch, with distinct facial features drawn in profile, round glasses, a cap, and a long coat with a visible collar. The person on the right has a rough, less defined outline, appears to be smiling, and is wearing a hat with a wide brim and a coat. There are no obvious signs of jewelry or objects being held by either person. The background is plain and uncluttered, with a light beige color, typical of sketch paper.
